move: word screws in rotation-first, letters late-spin, sparks burst, blows past camera
how: A violet radial stage with a dashed ring and a thin ring turning full opposite turns over the clip, a pink halo breathing scale 0.9 to 1.1, a 300px three-letter word, a masked subline and six sparks. The word comes from scale 0 rotation -540 to 1/0 (expo.out, 1.3s, at 2%) with a second scale tween from 0 with back.out(2.2) overriding it for the overshoot; at 15% each letter spins from rotation 180 scale 0.6 to rest with back.out(1.8) 0.09s apart; the subline rises. At 23% six sparks fly from the centre along fixed angles to 380x280px, growing scale 1.4 and fading (expo.out). At 81% the word blows to scale 4 rotation 90 and opacity 0 (expo.in) and the subline exits.
adapt: Change the word (any short string, letters spin individually), the accent letter colour, subline, ring and halo colours; keep the -540 rotation lead, back.out(2.2) scale overshoot and the scale-4 exit.
port: mount(el, shot) splits the word into spans and creates the rings, halo and sparks; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with entry at 0.02D, letter spins 0.15D, sparks 0.23D, exit 0.81D. Scope selectors to el; direct port.
caveats: two overlapping fromTo scale tweens on the same element; the later back.out one wins the overshoot
